correctness.summary: For an (n-1)-vertex connected mutual-visibility set, every non-edge among retained vertices must use the unique omitted vertex as the internal point of an avoiding geodesic. This yields an exact local condition, equivalent to a star component in the complement. The co-connected bounds follow symmetrically, and the sharp family is evaluated using the published block and complete-bipartite formulas.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The full available text of arXiv:2609.18877 was inspected. It proves the general Nordhaus--Gaddum bounds and excludes simultaneous values (n-1,n-1), but does not state the near-maximum star-component characterization or the sharper co-connected bounds. Exact and synonymous searches found no prior coverage.

value.summary: The result determines the complete structure at the first level below the maximum of a newly introduced invariant and gives strictly stronger Nordhaus--Gaddum sum and product bounds for co-connected graphs, sharp for every order n at least 4.

limitations: The n-2 level is not characterized.
Equality cases of the sharpened co-connected inequalities are not classified.
No claim is made for other mutual-visibility variants.
Originality remains to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from very recent or unindexed parallel work.
Independent audit has not been performed.
